profile.summary: Hi, I’m Shahil — a Forward Deployed Software Engineer @ Palantir based in NYC. I earned my B.S. in Computer Science from Rutgers University–New Brunswick. Feel free to reach out on LinkedIn or shoot me an email at shahilp@gmail.com!

positions.locationName: New York, New York, United States
positions.description:
Application Engineering Team ⚙️

• Engineered the backend for an internal AWS EKS-based Onboarding Tracker website that services sub-500ms latency endpoints and facilitates near real-time status updates for 500+ new hires using Golang, AWS, PostgreSQL, Terraform, GitHub Actions, and Docker
• Built an internal full-stack Okta application that provides multiple teams with an easy way to query Snowflake data for use in legal matter processing, streamlining the process by 47% while using Golang, AWS, Terraform, React, GitHub Actions, and Docker
• Developed a Snowflake database abstraction layer module as part of an internal Golang library that provides 9+ teams and over 100+ engineers with a way to seamlessly integrate Snowflake into internal tools, automation, and projects with minimal code

positions.title: Software Engineer Intern
positions.description:
Infosec Dev Team - Application Engineering Team ⚙️

• Created an internal service that automatically updates Splunk lookup tables with current AWS Stewards data for 3+ teams and 22+ engineers using Go, Python, GitHub Actions, Terraform, and AWS while on the Application Engineering team
• Engineered 5+ responsive Grafana Dashboards to display metrics from multiple lambdas and microservices
• Developed reusable CI pipelines for 100+ developers for security analysis using GitHub Actions and Snyk

positions.title: Machine Learning Researcher
positions.locationName: New Brunswick, New Jersey, United States · Hybrid
positions.description:
AI-Aided Rail Logistics and Safety Team 🔬

• Retrained multiple custom YOLOv5 models using PyTorch, hyperparameter tuning, dataset splitting, scaling, and classifier training, reducing the models’ false positive rate on average by 15% and false negative rate by 19% in 3 different object classes
• Expanded upon a Python webapp that generates geolocational and trespassing visualizations, optimizing calculation/display delay by 21% and improves rendering efficiency by 16% while using Flask, Dash, and trespassing data for 5+ researchers
• Built CI/CD pipelines for 3 webapps and edge servers deployed on 20+ trains using AWS CodeBuild, CodeDeploy, and CodePipeline
positions.insights: Skills: Python (Programming Language) · Amazon Web Services (AWS) · Software Development · Machine Learning · CI/CD

projects.title: RUPlatePal
projects.description: Ever wonder what happens to the leftovers at Rutgers? RUPlatePal serves as the bridge between the dining hall and food pantries by optimizing the resources and generating instructions! RUPlatePal is B2B solution that helps those in need by allowing food pantry's to optimally manage their food and leftover food from the dining halls

projects.title: Athena
projects.description: Athena parses through mp4,mp3 and wav files and created a text transcript of the video. Using that transcript, our team uses a modified version of the SMMRY algorithm (used to power TLDRs on websites like Reddit) that also accounts for correlation to a given topic, to find the n most important sentences in that video.
